scripts.build:remotes: npm run build -w mfe-auth && npm run build -w mfe-wallet && npm run build -w mfe-topup && npm run build -w mfe-transfer && npm run build -w mfe-bill-payment
scripts.preview:remotes: concurrently -k -n auth,wallet,topup,transfer,bill-payment -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run preview -w mfe-auth" "npm run preview -w mfe-wallet" "npm run preview -w mfe-topup" "npm run preview -w mfe-transfer" "npm run preview -w mfe-bill-payment"
scripts.dev: npm run build:remotes && concurrently -k -n remotes,shell "npm run preview:remotes" "npm run dev:shell"
